title: The leak scan flags the EC armor label quoted before a repository path that has a segment longer than 16 characters, which passed before BG-nx6jzvop's path lookahead
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits does not flag the EC armor label quoted directly before a repository path whose segment is longer than 16 letters or digits, such as the ConfigurationProfiles.md page or the ConditionalAccessPolicies-and-more.md page, and still flags a single-line EC key body of 78 characters that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon
d = "-" * 5
arm = d + "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY" + d
hit = lambda t: any(k == "secret" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t))
paths = ["kb/public/Intune/ConfigurationProfiles.md page", "kb/public/Entra/ConditionalAccessPolicies-and-more.md page", "kb/public/AutopilotDeployment/Profile2.json page"]
false = [p for p in paths if hit(arm + " " + p)]
body = "MHcCAQEEIGtq3xaH5wq7CUAKmJdZ0PY4RnXqPIYV1S2qt1NWOEHJoAoGCCqGSM49AwEHoUQDQgAE"
miss = [s for s in (".", "_x", "-x", ".pem") if not hit(arm + " " + body + s)]
print("path flagged:", false, "78-character body not flagged:", miss)
sys.exit(1 if false or miss else 0)

clauses.clause: kbcommon.leak_hits does not flag the EC armor label quoted directly before a repository path whose segment is longer than 16 letters or digits, such as the ConfigurationProfiles.md page or the ConditionalAccessPolicies-and-more.md page
still flags a single-line EC key body of 78 characters that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows
